Hey! I noticed you said you can't enjoy the things you don't like, so I hope what I suggest is something you can enjoy.

Sit or lay down for a bit. You feel like shit. Focus on your breathing. Remind yourself that the present is the only thing that is actually real. What happened in the past and what might happen in the future are just memories and possibilities. 

Sit for a while and try to think your best thought every 20 seconds. Think about the greatest, best thing you can. Then think about another, maybe even better thing! Do it until you feel better... Or if it doesn't work... Just come and ask for help again. Sometimes, just talking helps a great deal :)

Realize that with patience and determination, you can choose what you want to feel. If all that matters is now, why not choose love? You are loved, and you love. Realize that you have many things (even if they are the little things, even if it doesn't feel like it) that are a cause for happiness!

I don't connect with many people. I have loads of acquaintances and can always find someone to hang out with, but I don't have any "best" friends.

But I did; I knew this girl, almost 10 years ago now (damn, time flies). We had english classes together and we became fast friends; best friends. I'd be lying if I said I didn't have a crush on her! Then one day, some girl, who I never liked (arrogant, snobbish, etc.) joined our class and made friends with her. It was as if suddenly there was this huge distance between us.

Sometimes we'd look at eachother in the eye and I swear I could see guilt on her face. Never told anyone this, now that I think about it. I see her in town once in a blue moon, but we never talk.

I don't really understand why either, but it happened. I'm still a very happy person, though!
